During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Haka Hai]] lived in a '''compound''' in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].<ref name="DT 7" /> The compound contained a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] chamber<ref name="DT 8">[[Dark Times 8|''Dark Times'' 8]]</ref> as well as an [[Armory/Legends|armory]].<ref name="DT 9">[[Dark Times 9|''Dark Times'' 9]]</ref>
